open_points.subject: Required test 5 for preservation of the project request id
open_points.text:
5. A project correction leaves the facts it does not edit: the project's card
   answers the same `project_id`, status and created instant as before, and a
   create naming the project's original request id makes no second project.
open_points.question: What facts does the later create supply, and must it answer the corrected project as a repeat or be refused as a conflicting reuse of the request id? Merely requiring no second project leaves the required result undecided.
options: Supply the project's current corrected facts and require the existing corrected project to be answered unchanged.
Supply the original pre-correction facts and require refusal because those facts differ from the project's current facts.
open_points.default_guess: Supply the current corrected facts and require the existing project to be answered unchanged.

witness.initial: Project P was created with request id K and display name A, then corrected to display name B.
events: The owner submits another create naming K.
The create supplies either current facts with name B or original facts with name A.
outcomes: With current facts, A01 requires Registry to answer P unchanged.
With original facts, A01 requires Registry to refuse the create as a conflict.
witness.observer: The caller sees either the project answer or a refusal, although both histories create no second project.

open_points.subject: A04-3 and A04-6 coverage for Customer last-changed instants
open_points.text:
11. A correction that changes a project moves its revision by exactly one and
   sets its last-changed instant to the current instant; a correction that
   changes a Customer, and a mark that restricts it, each move the Customer's
   revision by exactly one; a correction of either that changes nothing
   leaves the revision, and the project's last-changed instant, where they
   were. Shows A04-3, A04-6.
open_points.question: What must this Required test show about the Customer's last-changed instant when a Customer correction or restriction changes it, and when a Customer correction changes nothing? A04-3 covers both record kinds, but the test states the timestamp result only for the Project.
options: Require each changing Customer correction and restriction to set the Customer's last-changed instant to the operation's current instant, and require a no-op Customer correction to preserve it.
Narrow A04-3 so it no longer guarantees the Customer's last-changed instant, contrary to State 1's revision-and-time pairing.
open_points.default_guess: Expand the Required test to assert the Customer timestamp moves with its revision and remains unchanged with a no-op correction.

witness.initial: A Customer has revision 4 and last-changed instant L.
events: The owner performs a valid changing correction at instant N.
In a second history, the owner submits an equal correction.
outcomes: An implementation may move the revision but leave last-changed at L because the test mentions only the Customer revision.
An implementation following A04-3 sets last-changed to N for the changing correction and preserves L for the equal correction.
witness.observer: The owner reading the Customer record sees the different last-changed instant.

open_points.subject: clock readings for a correction and its audit entry
open_points.text: sets its last-changed instant to the current instant
open_points.question: For an accepted changing correction that also writes its audit entry, is one UTC wall-clock reading shared by the record's last-changed instant and the audit entry, or are separate readings taken? State 2 must decide how many readings the operation takes.
options: Take one UTC wall-clock reading for the operation and use it for both the record's last-changed instant and its audit entry.
Take separate UTC wall-clock readings, allowing the two instants to differ.
open_points.default_guess: Take one UTC wall-clock reading and reuse it for every fresh recorded instant of the correction.

witness.initial: A project is corrected by an accepted action that writes both its new last-changed instant and an audit entry.
events: The clock advances between two possible reads during the transaction.
outcomes: With one reading, the project and audit entry carry the same instant.
With separate readings, the audit entry can carry a later instant than the project's last-changed instant.
witness.observer: The owner comparing the project card with the audit log sees the difference.

open_points.subject: initial access version of a re-registered session
open_points.text:
2. Registering the ended identity again answers a session with no granted
   project, no active project and no pending request, at access version 1.
open_points.rule:
У значения, которое читает генерируемый код, ровно три пути; путь
выбирается по тому, что это за значение, и у значения один дом (§15.4).
open_points.question: The passage must give the decided initial access-version value a valid path to generated code, such as a specifically named imported data-provider constant, rather than leaving generated code to invent or embed the value.

set_aside.subject: project and Customer correction instants
set_aside.text:
3. The facts a correction does not edit — identity, status, marks, instants,
   request id — are not part of it and do not change by it.
set_aside.question: Does an accepted correction preserve every instant as A03 says, or move the record's last-changed instant to the current instant as A04 and State 1 require? A03 must distinguish written-once instants from the system-maintained last-changed instant.
options: Exclude the last-changed instant from A03's preserved non-editable facts: created and other written-once instants stay, while last-changed moves on a changing correction.
Preserve the last-changed instant on correction, contrary to A04-3 and the Revisions and times requirement.
set_aside.default_guess: Treat created and other written-once instants as preserved, but move last-changed exactly once when the correction changes the record.

witness.initial: A project at revision 3 has created instant C and last-changed instant L.
events: The owner submits a valid correction changing the display name at current UTC instant N.
outcomes: A03 rule 3 gives created instant C and last-changed instant L after the correction.
A04-3 and Required test 11 give created instant C and last-changed instant N after the correction.
witness.observer: The owner reading the corrected project card or context sees whether registry_updated_at is L or N.
